content.text:
valhalla:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: 1
          memory: "157286400"
        reservations:
--
      STREAMLET_VALHALLA_URL: http://valhalla:8002
    image: ghcr.io/green-ecolution/streamlet/server:0.2.0
    labels:
      traefik.enable: "true"
      traefik.http.routers.streamlet.entrypoints: websecure
      traefik.http.routers.streamlet.rule: Host(`streamlet.localhost`)
    networks:
      default: null
    ports:
--

observation.command:
cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/override.yaml <<'EOF'
services:
  valhalla:
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations: null
        limits: null
  streamlet:
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations: null
        limits: null
EOF
docker compose -f compose.yaml -f /tmp/override.yaml config 2>/dev/null | grep -A8 "valhalla:" | head -20
